macro.interface: Cross-host engineering rules and passive repository context
macro.responsibility: Load stable repo rules before orchestration begins.
macro.forbidden: Do not copy small-loop domain truth into the repository entry contract.

test_contract.positive: Canonical entry files resolve and remain readable.
test_contract.negative: Missing or malformed governance entry fails the owning conformance gate.
test_contract.evidence: Mechanical exit code and named file diagnostics.

macro.responsibility: Apply least-privilege commit-time policy through the repository hook.
macro.forbidden: Do not hide authorization in per-loop host settings or bypass hooks.

test_contract.positive: Allowed local mechanical gates execute through the declared layer.
test_contract.negative: Unregistered or failing gates block the commit layer.
test_contract.evidence: Layer report and hook exit code.

macro.interface: Repository lifecycle hooks and observable transitions
macro.responsibility: Observe commit, message, and push transitions without granting LAND.
macro.forbidden: Do not treat hook success as semantic graduation.

test_contract.positive: Registered hook checks report their physical result.
test_contract.negative: Broken selftests or protected-history violations fail closed.
test_contract.evidence: Hook output, meta-gate output, and Git status.

macro.interface: Capability discovery without concrete plan selection
macro.responsibility: Expose available Skills, actors, validators, and route capabilities.
macro.forbidden: Do not store the active operational DAG in a capability catalog.

test_contract.positive: Selected capabilities resolve to digest-pinned catalog entries.
test_contract.negative: Unknown routes, selection prose, or digest drift are rejected.

macro.interface: Plan composition and independent judgment specialization
macro.responsibility: Select narrow Skills and judges for each plan node.
macro.forbidden: Do not inject every Skill into every node or let a judge self-LAND.

test_contract.positive: A typed plan binds one actor, validator, context set, and bounded edge per node.
test_contract.negative: Actor soup, unbounded review, or missing fixed context fails.

macro.responsibility: Run repo-wide gates and validate plans independently of implementing actors.
macro.forbidden: Do not let the writer manufacture its own receipt or semantic verdict.

test_contract.positive: Registered gates and their selftests execute at the declared layer.
test_contract.negative: Placebo selftests, forged receipts, and stale packages fail.
test_contract.evidence: L1/meta/push/full reports plus separate findings receipts.

macro.interface: Versioned intent, requirements, acceptance, and stop conditions
macro.responsibility: Freeze why, scope, success criteria, and repair budget before execution.
macro.forbidden: Do not rewrite the plan merely to fit observed output.

test_contract.positive: A plan package has intent, context, topology, lock, and bounded acceptance.
test_contract.negative: Missing context, cycles, writer collisions, or unbounded repair fail.

macro.interface: Operational DAG, evolution history, and receipt state
macro.responsibility: Persist generation, supersession, node state, probes, and Human boundaries.
macro.forbidden: Do not use chat memory or a Markdown status view as runtime state.

test_contract.positive: A current generation replays through digest-bound node receipts.
test_contract.negative: Stale HEAD, wrong generation, dangling evidence, or self-admit fails.

small.interface: Loop-local passive context and driver entry
small.responsibility: Load common loop rules and explicit non-Claude entry pointers.
small.forbidden: Do not maintain two independent governance SSOTs.

test_contract.positive: Both entry files exist and point to the same target and route contracts.
test_contract.negative: A missing entry or duplicate governance owner fails the manifest gate.

small.interface: Single-dispatch driver and explicit permission surface
small.responsibility: Dispatch a selected driver with explicit target, feedback, and noninteractive input.
small.forbidden: Do not place iteration logic or hidden host authorization in the loop.

test_contract.positive: Every supported driver receives the same target and feedback contract.
test_contract.negative: Dropped feedback, interactive stdin, or unknown driver fails.

small.interface: Loop-local logs, anti-pattern history, and engine observations
small.responsibility: Keep runtime observations and failure history local to the sandbox.
small.forbidden: Do not use global mutable state or silently discard failed trajectories.

test_contract.positive: Engine transitions emit progress and trajectory observations.
test_contract.negative: No-progress, no-change, and exhausted runs surface distinct failures.
test_contract.evidence: Engine result line, exit code, trajectory, and anti entry.

small.interface: Loop-local capability and exchange route catalog
small.responsibility: Expose domain actors, Skills, validators, packet kinds, and fallback edges.
small.forbidden: Do not command sibling loops or store a concrete plan DAG here.

test_contract.positive: The template contains an explicit capability-versus-selection boundary.
test_contract.negative: Missing route owner or hidden free-form workflow state fails.
test_contract.evidence: Dual-loop manifest and instantiated route validator output.

small.interface: Typed exchange seam for domain-local adapters
small.responsibility: Carry fixed, iteration, and emergent context through validated packets.
small.forbidden: Do not pass hidden chat state or let a domain adapter take orchestration authority.

test_contract.positive: An instantiated loop names a typed packet schema and validator.
test_contract.negative: Unsafe paths, missing identity, or undeclared context fail closed.
test_contract.evidence: Packet schema validation and trigger/fallback tests.

small.responsibility: Measure the target with true exit codes and discriminate good from hollow fixtures.
small.forbidden: Do not let the writer edit the checker or infer success from prose.

test_contract.positive: Good fixtures pass and real target commands return the declared exit.
test_contract.negative: Hollow and planted-defect fixtures fail with diagnostic output.
test_contract.evidence: Verifier output, PROGRESS, and selftest discrimination result.

small.interface: Loop target, guard metric, success criteria, and stop-loss
small.responsibility: Freeze the operation contract before a driver runs.
small.forbidden: Do not change the scoring rule after seeing the result.

test_contract.positive: The engine receives a concrete target and predeclared success criteria.
test_contract.negative: Missing target, malformed contract, or checker mutation fails.
test_contract.evidence: Preflight result and immutable target contract.

small.interface: Loop status, verifier assignment, iteration history, and Human edge
small.responsibility: Persist bounded progress and surface stop-loss without self-admission.
small.forbidden: Do not hide state in the conversation or mark done from a driver result.

test_contract.positive: Each iteration records driver, exit, progress, and next edge.
test_contract.negative: No-progress or exhausted budget surfaces to Human instead of looping forever.
test_contract.evidence: PLAN trajectory and engine terminal result.
